en.t: The date was set for the seventh day of the ninth month.

units.source_text: 斋宫下伊势的行期就在目前了，行色匆匆，六条妃子甚是忙乱。

en.t: The Saigu's departure for Ise was now close at hand, and amid the hurried preparations, Lady Rokujo was terribly busy and unsettled.

units.source_text: 但源氏大将屡次去信说：“即使立谈也好。”

en.t: But Captain Genji sent letters again and again, saying, "Even a brief conversation while standing would be enough."
Lady Rokujo could not make up her mind.

units.source_text: 继而想道：“我过分韬晦，也很沉闷，不如和他隔帘相见吧。”

en.t: Then she thought, "Hiding myself away so completely is dreary too. I may as well meet him from behind the blinds."

units.source_text: 决定后，便悄悄地等候他来。

en.t: Once she had decided, she quietly waited for him to come.
